description: Reads a result summary that a Pro user handed over with the Hand to AI button in the Strategy Miner results (id from the user). Hand to AI is Pro only: a trial run has no Hand to AI button, so a user who is not on Pro has no id to give. Returns the settings used, the realistic-cost settings if on, how many strategies each check removed and why, the four robustness tests, the strict re-checks when they ran (trade resampling, walk-forward optimisation, a re-run with price noise and changed settings; candidate.robust holds each test's pass/fail and numbers), and per-candidate metrics (search period, later period, other symbols, robustness, equity drawdown, bars where stop and target were both reached). It contains no strategy design (no conditions, no code) and never runs the generator or exports anything. The id expires 30 days after creation and the user can delete it. To propose next settings, build a link with open_strategy_miner. Past results say nothing certain about the future; do not describe them as profitable.

id.description: The result id the user copied from the results screen
